verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਕੀਹ ਪਉੜੀਆਂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਭੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh ikeeh pauReeaa(n) gurmukh sukhafal nij ghar bhoiee|

en.bdb: Crossing the stairs of identities, the gurmukh under the guidance of the Guru comes to reside in his own true nature.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਦਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat hai sahaj ghar simaran dharas paras gun goiee|

en.bdb: Holy congregation, the source of remembrance of the Lord, His sight and touch, is the abode of equipoise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਹਾ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸੁਇਨਿਅਹੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਜਿਉਂ ਅਵਿਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: lohaa suinaa hoi kai suiniahu suinaa jiau(n) aviloiee|

en.bdb: Holy congregation is such a gold whose ingredients i.e. people therein, once known fir their qualities of iron have now become gold and are seen as gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਬੋਹੈ ਨਿੰਮੁ ਵਣੁ ਨਿੰਮਹੁ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਪਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan bohai ni(n)m van ni(n)mahu cha(n)dhan birakh paloiee|

en.bdb: Even margosa tree, Azadirachta indica, becomes sandal in the company of sandal tree.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੰਗੋਦਕ ਚਰਣੋਦਕਹੁ ਗੰਗੋਦਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੰਗਾ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: ga(n)godhak charanodhakahu ga(n)godhak mil ga(n)gaa hoiee|

en.bdb: Water made dirty by feet also becomes pure when it meets the Ganges.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਗਹੁ ਹੰਸੁ ਸੁਵੰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਹੰਸਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸੁ ਵਿਰਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: kaagahu ha(n)s suva(n)s hoi ha(n)sahu param ha(n)s viraloiee|

en.bdb: Any crow of good breed may become swan but rare is the swan, which becomes supreme swan of rare and highest order.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੰਸੀ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸੁ ਕੂੜ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਖੀਰੁ ਵਿਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh va(n)see param ha(n)s kooR sach neer kheer viloiee|

en.bdb: Born in the family of gurmukh is the paramhans (man of highest spiritual order), who separate milk and water of truth and falsehood by his discerning wisdom.
(In the holy congregation) the disciple is the Guru and the Guru (most humbly) becomes disciple.
